title: Pages continue after the last key
description:
As a client paging through results, I want the next page to continue after the last record I saw, so that inserts between pages never repeat or skip records.

```gherkin
Feature: Key-based pagination
  Scenario: Inserting before the cursor neither repeats nor skips records
    Given a table "items" with records "a", "c", "e", "g", "i", "k"
    When I list "items" with limit 3
    Then the page is "a", "c", "e" and a next token is returned
    When I put record "b" into "items"
    And I list "items" with limit 3 and that next token
    Then the page is "g", "i", "k"

  Scenario: A token from a different query is rejected
    Given a next token from listing "items"
    When I query index "by_x" on "items" with that token
    Then the result is an error of kind "InvalidToken"
```
